spec.query: SELECT non_negative_difference(last("value")) FROM "electric_measurement" WHERE ("machine"::tag =~ /^$machine$/ AND "name"::tag = 'Total Import Active Energy') AND $timeFilter GROUP BY time($d_interval), "name"::tag, "machine"::tag fill(null)

SELECT SUM("hourly_consumption") AS "energy_consumption"
FROM (
    SELECT NON_NEGATIVE_DERIVATIVE(LAST("value"), 1h) AS "hourly_consumption"
    FROM "electric_measurement"
    WHERE (
        "machine"::tag =~ /^$machine$/
        AND "name"::tag = 'Total Import Active Energy'
    )
    AND $timeFilter
    GROUP BY time(1h), "name"::tag, "machine"::tag, "shift"::tag fill(none)
)
WHERE $timeFilter
GROUP BY time($d_interval), "name"::tag, "machine"::tag, "shift"::tag
